title: Correct Ampere force magnitude
description: Essential: The response must state the correct numerical value for the Ampere force (0.4 N).

title: Correct friction coefficient
description: Essential: The response must state the correct numerical value for the coefficient of kinetic friction (0.5).

title: Current calculation
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply Ohm's law for the closed circuit to find the current (I = E/(R+r)).

title: Force balance parallel to incline
description: Important: The solution must set up the correct force equilibrium equation along the incline (mg sinθ + f = F_Ampere).

title: Normal force calculation
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the normal force from the perpendicular force balance (mg cosθ).

title: Ampere force direction
description: Optional: The response may correctly identify the direction of the Ampere force (up the incline).

title: Sign error in force balance
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly places the Ampere force and friction/gravity on the same side of the equilibrium equation.

title: Incorrect circuit resistance
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student omits the internal resistance or uses an incorrect total resistance in the current calculation.
